label: Press controls separate conservation, joint effect production and secondary application
paraphrase: Three exercise profiles have the same actual on/on episode, three actual bearers, a universal esse giver, an actual stroke producing the imprint and source drive producing a separate indicator. In conservation alone the stroke has no recorded actual lender and the source lacks path credit for the imprint. In effect-side cooperation the stroke still has no actual lender; drive and stroke are each scenario-indispensable within the jointly sufficient imprint record. Source and agent earn credit at that imprint, but the source has no path to the stroke and universal transfer fails. With application the drive acts through the secondary stroke with retained capacity and an actual lender. No direct drive-imprint step exists, while joint credit and universal transfer hold in the selected finite profile. These are structural comparisons conditional on the events, exercise records and selected credit interpretation.
